playbookOutputs: Confirmation of registration from the Compensation Fund
Guidance note on the annual Return of Earnings and Letter of Good Standing
playbookCommonFailures: Proof of banking details is a transaction statement or in a director's name instead of the company's
Certified director ID older than 3 months or certification stamp illegible
Estimated annual payroll left blank or given as a monthly figure, producing a wrong assessment
Nature of business described too vaguely for the Compensation Fund to assign a subclass
The employer is already registered under an old 99-number, so a new application is rejected as a duplicate

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (CIPC COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2 for a CC) showing the registered name, enterprise number and active directors. The employer being registered is the company, not the ordering contact.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) / Owner (s) Certified ID document(s)   - not older than 3 months
alternatives: Certified passport copy for a foreign director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified copy of the green ID book or smart-card ID (both sides) for every director on the CoR14.3. Certification stamp, signature and date must be visible and dated within the last 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address  - not older than 3 months
alternatives: Bank statement showing the business address
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, municipal account or lease showing the physical business address, dated within 3 months. The address must be a street address the Compensation Fund can inspect, not only a PO Box.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of banking details  - not older than 3 months
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the COMPANY's name, dated within 3 months. Accept a bank stamp OR a digital verification reference / QR code. A transaction statement is NOT acceptable.

informationToProvide.label: Estimated annual payroll figures
informationToProvide.aiHint: Total estimated gross earnings for ALL employees (including working directors) for the current assessment year (1 March to 28/29 February), plus the number of employees. If the client gives a monthly figure, multiply by 12 and confirm with them before use.

informationToProvide.label: Tax Clearance Certificate
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN letter for the company. Also use it to read the company's income tax reference number, which the W.As.2 form asks for.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect COIDA registration requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every required item uploaded, payroll estimate and employee count answered
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing. Explain that the Compensation Fund needs the company's own bank letter (not a director's) and a physical business address. Ask specifically for the nature of business in plain words (what the business does, where, with what equipment) — this drives the subclass and assessment rate. Ask whether the business has ever had a COIDA / 99-number before; if yes, this is a reactivation, not a new registration. Do not promise a shorter turnaround than 1–2 working days for submission; the Fund's own processing can take longer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against Compensation Fund requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CoR14.3, bank letter and proof of address must all be in the company's name and agree on the registered name. Director names on the CoR14.3 must match the certified IDs. Certification dates within 90 days. Extract: enterprise number, income tax number (from TCS), physical and postal address, director ID numbers, bank details, employee count, annual payroll estimate.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare W.As.2 registration values hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every W.As.2 field value posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Lay out every field the Compensation Fund employer registration (form W.As.2 — ⚠ verify the current online form still mirrors W.As.2) asks for: employer legal name and trading name, CIPC number, income tax number, physical/postal addresses, contact person, bank details, date business commenced / first employee date, number of employees, estimated annual earnings, and a suggested nature-of-business description with a proposed subclass. Mark the subclass as a suggestion only — Kevin decides. Never invent a commencement date; leave blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Register employer on the Compensation Fund online system
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application submitted on the Compensation Fund online system and a reference / 99-number captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: ⚠ CHANNEL: plan §4.3 marks this ⚠ — confirm with Kevin whether registration is done on the Compensation Fund online employer portal (CF-Filing / CompEasy) under our organisation login, or by submitting the W.As.2 with attachments by email. Attachments: CoR14.3, certified IDs, proof of address, bank letter, TCS. Nature of business and subclass require judgement, so this step is manual. Record the reference number and a screenshot of the confirmation screen in the order.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for the Compensation Fund to issue the registration number
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: COIDA registration number (99-series) received or a query raised by the Fund
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Some registrations return a number immediately on the portal; others go to a queue. If nothing arrives by the follow-up point, draft a status query to the Compensation Fund quoting the submission reference and the company's CIPC number. If the Fund queries the nature of business or asks for photos, create a proposal for Kevin with the query text.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver COIDA registration number and next-steps note to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registration confirmation and 99-number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the registration confirmation and the number. Explain in plain English that the annual Return of Earnings must be submitted every year (⚠ verify current deadline, normally 31 March, often extended) and that a Letter of Good Standing is only issued once the assessment is paid. Offer the COIDA Renewal service and the Letter of Good Standing on request. Do not promise the Letter of Good Standing as part of this order.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
